verdict.rationale: Penpot's own self-hosting lets users run it in environments they control, and it states it will never make business out of user data. Its MCP server can also be deployed without third-party clouds and paired with an agent the user trusts. Together these give users real control over where their design data goes, but nothing explicitly addresses AI model training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or opt-out for the hosted service, documentation on how data is handled when connected LLMs process it, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Keep your data private. Penpot will never make business out of your data. Choose where and how to host it, and decide who has access to it.
Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
Deploy the MCP server in your own environment without relying on third-party clouds.
Connect it to any AI agent or LLM you trust.
